messages.subject: Garnett Use Case Questions
parts:
Hi, 

I have a few questions about the use cases for Garnett:
* What is the minimum cell sample size?
* Can you still get meaningful data out of ambiguous markers?
* Can you use Garnett to divide a cell population on expression of only 2 genes (expression of X and Y, expression of only X, expression of only Y, expression of neither)? It would be convenient to have Garnett set the threshold between low and high expression.

Best,
Olaf

messages.author: 027760d088a56515
messages.subject: Re: Garnett Use Case Questions
parts:
Hi, The default minimum number of cells per cell type to be included is 8, you can modify the parameter min_observations in train_cell_classifier if you want to raise or lower the requirement. In practice, more cell examples will generate a more robust classifier.  I believe I answered your other questions in the previous post. 

Best,
Hannah
